# Statement blocks of the rendering head that no test in cmd/dinah executes.
#
# TestEveryStatementOfTheRenderingHeadIsCoveredOrNamed reads this file. Every
# entry is a place the output check does not look, so an entry is a finding
# rather than a line of configuration: it says a block prints for a reader and
# nothing in the suite has ever read what it prints. Two assertions keep the
# pressure on. An entry naming a block the suite does execute fails, so a stale
# entry is pruned rather than left to accumulate, and an entry carrying no
# reason fails, so nobody adds one without saying why the block is unreached.
#
# A line is the block, then whitespace, then the reason. A blank line and a
# line opening with a hash are commentary.
#
# Two kinds of entry sit here and the difference is worth reading. Some blocks
# cannot be reached from a test at all, and say so. The rest are reachable and
# simply unreached: each is a human rendering the suite has never printed, and
# each is worth a test rather than a permanent line here.

commands.go:372.2,373.10  runGuide printing one guide's text, which is reached only by naming a topic; the corpus asks for the topic listing and never for a guide.
help.go:125.32,127.3  verbHelp refusing a command it does not know, which runHelp settles before composing anything, so no invocation reaches it.
render.go:27.28,29.3  the warning line of a response, which no verb the corpus drives sets.
render.go:44.29,46.27  the stale outcome of a response, which the cli head cannot provoke: a stale revision needs a second writer between the read and the act.
render.go:46.27,48.4  the same, on the branch where the stale response carries a card.
render.go:49.3,49.102  the same, writing the stale sentence.
render.go:50.10,51.108  the unreachable outcome, which is by construction the outcome no invocation produces.
render.go:60.16,63.3  the branch where the machine form will not marshal, which needs a value the library cannot build.
render.go:93.19,95.3  a token the catalog carries no rendering for, and every token the head prints has one.
render.go:118.21,120.3  a served instruction offering no legal move, which needs a state with nothing after it.
render.go:166.2,166.25  the human rendering of a false answer, so a status or whoami printed by somebody who is not the operator. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:189.29,192.3  the sentence a listing prints when the state holds no card. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:269.23,272.3  a card carrying a body, printed under its own line by show. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:304.19,306.5  the override mark on a move in the history. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:307.30,308.20  the reason a block carries in the history. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:368.59,370.2  the human rendering of whoami, which the corpus asks for through --json alone. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:377.32,379.3  version reporting no catalog at all, which cannot happen while a catalog is embedded.
table.go:91.30,93.3  the shipped binary's branch, where no test hook is armed. The suite arms the recorder for its whole run, so this is unreachable from a test by construction.
